cards.name: Bradley Beal
cards.curated: The Wizards reward until 2026-09-18, when John Wall's 2016-17 Super Season took the goal (the user: "Go with Vince, Wall and Brand"). His 31-a-game year is nobody's best season by the rule (2018-19 is) and not his rookie year (2012-13, carded), so it keeps its card as a Throwback rather than vanishing. Nobody had earned it: "No one has them yet, it doesn't matter. But it should just change face."
